description: This file defines the Swagger API documentation classes for the GLAccounts API in the Fineract project, specifically providing schema annotations and response/request data models for the GLAccounts endpoints.

classes.name: GLAccountsApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Contains nested static classes representing API request and response schemas for GLAccounts endpoints.

classes.name: GetGLAccountsResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response of retrieving GL account details.

classes.name: GetGLAccountsTemplateResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response of retrieving available GL account template options.

classes.name: PostGLAccountsRequest
classes.description: Schema for creating a new GL account.

classes.name: PostGLAccountsResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response after creating a new GL account, mainly returning the resource ID.

classes.name: PutGLAccountsRequest
classes.description: Schema for updating an existing GL account.

classes.name: PutGLAccountsResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response after updating a GL account, including changes details.

classes.name: DeleteGLAccountsResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response after deleting a GL account, mainly returning the resource ID.
